report.summary: Reviewed chunk 2 of 15 of embeddings.py: defines AgentEvent, EmbeddingSpec, JournalPosition, ProjectionFilter dataclasses with validation and methods.
risks: AgentEvent.from_dict | medium | Assumes data['event_id'], data['event_type'], data['content'], data['timestamp'] exist; missing keys raise KeyError. | Add test with missing keys.
EmbeddingSpec.__post_init__ | low | Validation allows normalization 'l2' or 'none' but not others; caller may expect 'cosine' etc. | Confirm list of allowed values.
EmbeddingSpec.index_id | low | Uses _canonical_json from outside chunk; if that function changes, index_id changes. | Review _canonical_json implementation.
EmbeddingSpec.pins_model_revision | medium | Relies on MOVABLE_TAG_PROVIDERS defined outside chunk; if that set is wrong, logic is wrong. | Verify MOVABLE_TAG_PROVIDERS contents.
JournalPosition.__post_init__ | low | Rejects bool as position but bool is subclass of int; check isinstance(self.position, int) and not isinstance(self.position, bool). | Confirm intended behavior.

observations.what: AgentEvent.from_dict handles metadata as string by parsing JSON; but if metadata is not a string or dict, it will be left as-is, potentially causing issues.
EmbeddingSpec.__post_init__ validates fields but does not check that dimension is integer; it could be float, but dimension <= 0 check would still work.
JournalPosition.__post_init__ rejects bool as position, but bool is subclass of int; the check isinstance(self.position, bool) is redundant but explicit.
ProjectionFilter has no validation; fields are optional and no __post_init__.
